_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the event window is chosen with probability proportional to exp(log(2.5) x exposure)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same conditional log OR and SE, and the unmatched comparator
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: at most 2.2e-9 after pinning Newton in Python (5.4e-5 with ConditionalLogit's default). harness/instrument_examples.test.py finds the exact conditional MLE by Newton's method (agreeing to 1e-8), and over 100 seeds shows ordinary logistic regression ignoring the matching is attenuated by more than 0.1.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance separates the effect from zero. Measured by harness/instrument_examples.test.py, running python.py on seeds 0 to 99.
